mindtraced_atomic_units: Implement a dual-edge triggered D-type flip-flop using standard FPGA resources.
The output 'q' should update on both rising and falling edges of the clock 'clk'.
The output 'q' should update based on the input 'd' at the rising and falling edges of 'clk'.
spec_atomic_units: Implement a dual-edge triggered flip-flop using combinational logic and single-edge triggered flip-flops.
The output `q` updates on both rising and falling edges of the clock `clk`.
The value of `d` is captured at the rising and falling edges of `clk`.
Use two single-edge triggered flip-flops: one positive-edge triggered and one negative-edge triggered.
Combine the outputs of the two flip-flops using an XOR gate.
The input to the positive-edge triggered flip-flop is `d ^ n` (where n is the output of the negative-edge triggered flip-flop).
The input to the negative-edge triggered flip-flop is `d ^ p` (where p is the output of the positive-edge triggered flip-flop).
The final output 'q' is calculated as `p ^ n`.
If the input 'd' is asynchronous to the clock 'clk', implement a synchronizer circuit before the dual-edge emulation circuit.
The synchronizer consists of two flip-flops in series, clocked by 'clk'.
Apply constraints to the synchronizer flip-flops to prevent optimization.
